//: Shared Playwright-only tsconfig for every site (referenced via --tsconfig in each site's test script). Deliberately self-contained with no astro/tsconfigs/base extends: Playwright 1.62's config loader can't resolve that package specifier when astro is hoisted to the workspace-root node_modules, which aborts the run before any test executes. Paths are relative to this file (sites/). Only main-site's tests import source (via @utils, which pulls in @components etc.); the other subsites' tests import no aliases, so this single set covers them all.
